definingThreshold: Ineffective; sufficiently large fixed odd B; B=3 is not certified
arithmeticScope: Ordinary rational abc, the retained elliptic group and simultaneous prime-pattern inputs, and the prepared pole realization obtained from Jaswal, Hexagon 2611.00331v2, Theorem 1.2. The all-point trace-height lemma is proved separately from von Buhren (2017), Theorem 1.1.
squareRootsNotAssumed: The reciprocal auxiliary points need not have square abscissas.
